fichas.title: Fitness-room exercise equipment and dimensions
fichas.summary: Illustrated exercise equipment includes a rowing machine and bicycle ergometer, a stomach muscle board with push-up bar and wall bars, a multi-exercise centre, and a pulling machine. The drawings print several dimensions; the OCR does not make every dimension-to-equipment association fully clear.

fichas.title: Categories of machine by use
fichas.summary: A table classifies training areas A–E by equipment, exercises, motor functions, and training intention. Categories range from general single-joint stations to special apparatus and open warm-up areas; listed training intentions include fitness and condition.
furniture_equipment: Lifting surface with multipress or isometric bar

fichas.title: Conditioning and fitness rooms
fichas.summary: The page gives conditioning-room area options and an equipment schedule for room areas of 40 m², 80 m², and 200 m², with equipment quantities varying by area. It also shows an example layout for a 200 m² fitness room and notes that some apparatus types are available in different versions and should be selected to suit the chosen dumbbell and weight provision.
